_note: Poster-side ground truth used only to score third-party reviews after the hunt. It is never put in a model prompt (test-js/real-hunter.test.js checks this).

hook-vault.label: cross-function re-entrancy: withdraw() writes a cached balance back after the token's transfer hook, and transfer() is unguarded

init-vault.label: missing access control: initialize() can be called again by anyone

lend-pool.label: collateral priced from the exchange's spot reserve ratio, which the attacker moves in the same transaction

share-vault.label: first-depositor share inflation via donation and rounding
